scientific_integrity: The finite numerical checks corroborate only parameter instances; universal conclusions follow from the analytical proof and classical Bessel asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-distance thermodynamic-limit spatial pair-correlation averages, not individual microscopic two-spin measurements.
All-plus global Poisson resetting, infinite one-dimensional ferromagnetic Glauber chain with positive finite temperature and nonzero ferromagnetic coupling.
No finite-size edge-universality, noisy-data inverse guarantees, or extension to Metropolis dynamics.
The zero-coupling boundary is given separately; asymptotic constants are not uniform there.
Independent assessment and definitive publication-priority evaluation not performed.
title: A doubled resetting threshold and logarithmic edge singularity for Glauber–Ising spatial correlations
